name: v1
description: Initial evaluation suite for solo vs team comparison

tasks.name: Fix slugify truncation
tasks.prompt: The slugify() function in src/utils/text.ts truncates to 48 characters, but some labels are still too long. Change the maximum length to 64 characters and update the related test in test/text.test.mjs to verify the new limit.

tasks.name: Add team state cleanup function
tasks.prompt: Add a new function `cleanupTeamState(path: string): void` to src/team/state.ts that removes the team state JSON file if it exists. Export it from the module. Write a test for it in test/teamState.test.mjs that verifies the file is removed after calling cleanupTeamState.
acceptance: function removes the file at the given path
test/teamState.test.mjs contains a test for cleanupTeamState

tasks.name: Fix random agent selection
tasks.prompt: The randomAgent() function in src/team/profiles.ts uses Math.random() which is not deterministic. Add an optional seed parameter so that tests can produce reproducible results. Do not change the public behavior when no seed is provided. Write a test in test/teamProfiles.test.mjs that verifies seeded selection is deterministic.
acceptance: randomAgent accepts an optional seed parameter
existing behavior is preserved when seed is not provided

tasks.name: Add diff scope grader
tasks.prompt: Add a new grader type `diff-scope` to the eval system. It should accept a list of allowed path glob patterns and verify that the agent's diff only touches files matching those patterns. Implement it in src/eval/graders.ts and add a corresponding type to src/eval/types.ts. Write a unit test in test/eval.test.mjs.
acceptance: grader checks diff paths against allowed patterns
test/eval.test.mjs contains a test for diff-scope grader

tasks.name: Add eval validate command
tasks.prompt: Add a `validate` subcommand to the eval CLI that checks whether a suite file is well-formed. It should verify all tasks have required fields (id, prompt, fixture, graders) and report any validation errors. Implement it in src/commands/eval.ts. Write a test in test/eval.test.mjs that validates a known good suite and catches a malformed one.
acceptance: herdr-worktree-dispatcher eval validate --suite v1 runs without error
malformed suite files produce descriptive error messages

tasks.name: Fix parseExitCode edge case
tasks.prompt: The parseExitCode function in src/commands/team.ts should handle the edge case where an empty string is passed as the exit code. Currently it may return NaN. Fix it to return undefined for empty strings and write a regression test in test/teamCommands.test.mjs.

tasks.name: Add full run trace aggregation
tasks.prompt: Add a function `loadRunRecords(runId: string): TraceRecord[]` to src/trace/stats.ts that scans all agent trace files under the run directory (traceRoot()/runs/<runId>/agents/*.jsonl) and returns merged records. This enables proper team trace aggregation. Write a test in test/trace.test.mjs that creates mock trace files for multiple agents and verifies they are all loaded.
acceptance: function reads all .jsonl files in the run's agents directory
records from all agents are merged and deduplicated
test/trace.test.mjs contains a multi-agent aggregation test

tasks.name: Add cost metrics to report
tasks.prompt: Extend the eval report in src/eval/report.ts to include a cost-efficiency section showing cost per successful task for each arm (total wall time / pass count). Also add a section showing the top 3 slowest tasks. Write a test in test/eval.test.mjs that verifies the report output contains these sections.
acceptance: report includes cost per successful task for solo and team
report includes top 3 slowest tasks section

tasks.name: Add batch task retry with backoff
tasks.prompt: Add retry functionality to the batch system. When a batch task fails during dispatch, it should be automatically retried up to 3 times with exponential backoff (1s, 2s, 4s). Implement this in src/batch/manager.ts. Add a `retry_count` field to BatchTask in src/batch/types.ts. Track retry attempts and final status. Write tests in test/batchManager.test.mjs that verify retry logic, backoff timing, and max retry limit.
acceptance: Failed tasks are retried up to 3 times

tasks.name: Add connector health check
tasks.prompt: Add a health check system for connectors. Create a new file src/connectors/health.ts with a `checkConnectorHealth(connectorType: string): Promise<HealthStatus>` function. It should verify the connector is installed, can be imported, and responds within 5 seconds. Integrate this into src/connectors/registry.ts. Write tests in test/connectorRegistry.test.mjs that verify health checks for valid and invalid connectors.
acceptance: HealthStatus type includes status, latency, and error fields
Registry integrates health check on connector resolution

tasks.name: Add trace export to JSON and CSV
tasks.prompt: Add trace export functionality. Create src/trace/export.ts with functions `exportTraceToJSON(runId: string, outputPath: string)` and `exportTraceToCSV(runId: string, outputPath: string)`. JSON export should include all trace records with metadata. CSV export should flatten the data for spreadsheet analysis. Write tests in test/trace.test.mjs that verify both export formats produce valid output files.
acceptance: src/trace/export.ts exists with exportTraceToJSON and exportTraceToCSV
JSON export includes run metadata and all trace records
CSV export has proper headers and flattened data

tasks.name: Add config validation with detailed errors
tasks.prompt: Add comprehensive config validation. Create src/config/validator.ts with a `validateConfig(configPath: string): ValidationResult` function. It should check all supported keys, validate types, detect unknown keys, and provide line-number-specific error messages. Integrate into src/config/config.ts so invalid configs fail fast with clear errors. Write tests in a new test/configValidator.test.mjs that verify validation of valid configs, unknown keys, type errors, and missing required fields.
acceptance: ValidationResult includes errors with line numbers
Unknown keys are detected and reported
Type mismatches are detected (e.g., string where boolean expected)
